editorial.blurb: Taquizas Don Rafa is an authentic Mexican buffet where hospitality and homemade flavor shine through in every dish, from traditional guisados to fresh-made specialties.
editorial.insiderTip: Go Tuesday through Sunday for the full buffet experience with 24+ guisados; order pancakes, waffles, sopes, huaraches, or chilaquiles fresh from the grill at no extra charge.
